product_family: AI-powered internal knowledge base and Slack Q&A bot ("Kai") for internal documentation, knowledge management, and repetitive-question deflection; single core product sold on Scaling and Enterprise tiers (Enterprise adds SSO/SCIM).

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type 1/2)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Tettra has no dedicated trust center; its security overview, help-center security section, and privacy policy make no mention of SOC 2 or any third-party audit report.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. No mention of ISO 27001 or any ISO certification anywhere on tettra.com or support.tettra.com.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of a HIPAA compliance program or BAA offering. Not mentioned in the security overview, privacy policy, or help docs.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: Tettra itself is not PCI-certified; its payment processor is. "Our credit card processor, Stripe, is certified to PCI Service Provider Level 1, the most stringent level of certification available." This is the payment vendor's (Stripe's) certification, not Tettra's.

certifications.name: GDPR (posture)
certifications.proof_quote: "Tettra is dedicated to protecting the information we collect about you and fulfilling all obligations to you in compliance with the GDPR." Also: "We do not use the Privacy Shield to transfer your data. All sub-processors who previously used the Privacy Shield have updated to use SCC."

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI governance)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of an AI management-system certification. Not referenced anywhere on tettra.com or its help docs.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. No CSA STAR registry entry or self-assessment referenced on the vendor's site.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Not a government/federal-focused product; no FedRAMP mention anywhere on the vendor's site.

privacy.ai_training_note: Privacy policy explicitly states: "We WILL NOT use your Google Workspace or Slack data to develop, improve, or train generalized AI and/or ML models." OpenAI is listed as a sub-processor (powers the Kai AI bot/answers feature) but customer content is not used to train foundation models. No public per-tier opt-out toggle was found; the no-training commitment appears to apply account-wide. Note: Tettra explicitly does NOT offer a standalone DPA ("At this time, we are not planning on providing a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) separate from our updated Terms of Service" per help docs), which is a gap relative to enterprise expectations.
privacy.data_region: United States ("secured and encrypted servers located in the United States" per privacy policy); infrastructure hosted on Heroku with AWS for database/backups per security overview.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: All data sent via Tettra uses HTTPS.

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: Both the primary database and all backups are encrypted.

security.name: Authentication
security.value: OAuth via Slack or Google; Enterprise tier adds SSO & SCIM.

security.name: Hosting infrastructure
security.value: Application hosted on Heroku; database and backups hosted on Amazon AWS.

security.name: Backups
security.value: Customer account data backed up every day; self-serve HTML export available at any time.

security.name: Employee access controls
security.value: Strict policies on employee access to customer data; customer notified and written consent obtained where practical; granular audit logs of data access maintained.

security.name: Breach notification
security.value: Notifies customers in writing within 72 hours of verifying a security breach affecting their data.

products.name: Tettra (Scaling plan)
products.category: Internal knowledge base + AI Q&A (Slack bot)
products.data_scope: Company internal documentation, Google Docs/PDF imports, Slack conversation content indexed for Q&A
products.notes: $8/user/month (10-user minimum), all AI features included (Kai bot, page tagging, FAQ generation), API access, unlimited storage/version history.

products.name: Tettra (Enterprise plan)
products.category: Internal knowledge base + AI Q&A, enterprise tier
products.data_scope: Same data scope as Scaling plan; adds SSO/SCIM-gated identity and provisioning controls
products.notes: Custom pricing (discounts at 250+ licenses); adds SSO & SCIM, custom onboarding/import, custom reporting, priority/dedicated support.

compare.pricing_model: Per-user/month subscription (Scaling: $8/user/mo, 10-user minimum) plus a custom-priced Enterprise tier with SSO/SCIM; 30-day free trial.
compare.data_residency: United States only (no stated multi-region or EU-hosting option found)

flags: No dedicated trust center or third-party audit report (SOC 2 / ISO 27001) found anywhere on tettra.com, support.tettra.com, or via search; the absence is corroborated across three vendor-owned sources (security overview, help docs, privacy policy).

Vendor explicitly states it does NOT offer a standalone Data Processing Agreement (DPA) separate from its Terms of Service, which may not satisfy enterprise/EU procurement requirements despite its GDPR posture.
PCI DSS reference on the security page belongs to Stripe (Tettra's payment processor), not Tettra itself.

Not to be confused with "Tettra Health" (tettrahealth.com), an unrelated company with a similar name. This report covers Tettra, Inc. (tettra.com / tettra.co), the internal knowledge base / Slack Q&A product.
OpenAI is listed as a sub-processor for AI features; the sub-processor list can change without a formal changelog entry.
